source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 2, 8. Πᾶσαν γὰρ αὐτῆς ἀφεῖλεν ἀσφάλειαν, τῆς τιμωρίας ἐκτείνας τὸ μέτρον· ὃ δὴ καὶ Ζαχαρίας τεθέαται.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] For he has taken away all her security, having stretched out the measure of the punishment—which indeed Zechariah also has seen.
pass_b_english: For he has taken away all her security, having stretched out the measure of the punishment—which indeed Zechariah also has seen (Lamentations 2:8) (Zechariah 2:1–2).

choices.why: Origen’s Lam 1:22 turns on punitive-yet-healing divine visitation.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations disclosed in translator_notes.
